news.headline: Trump approval falls to record low of 31% as midterms near
news.body: A Reuters/Ipsos poll concluded on Oct. 19 found President Donald Trump’s approval rating at 31%, the lowest level recorded in either of his terms. The poll also showed a 47% to 35% Democratic advantage on the generic congressional ballot, indicating potential midterm gains for Democrats on Nov. 3, 2026.
